name: Water Dragon Jutsu
description: A long sequence of hand seals and a sweeping arm motion summon a serpentine dragon shape from a nearby water source.

steps.instruction: Begin in a wide, grounded stance facing your water source.
Move through a rapid sequence of hand seals.
Sweep both arms outward and upward in a rising arc.
Bring your hands forward together, palms out.
Follow through with a twisting motion as if guiding a coiling shape.
